items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: But one of the most, I would say, significant people in the band, for more than one reason, was a young man who was 18 years old at that particular time. His name was Oliver Nelson.

ctx.x: Anyway, he sat down and he played one number. And evidently... He sounded good, but there wasn't nothing extra about it. But he got up and he said, "Man, I don't dig the piano." The piano that they had down there was a console -- I

think it was a Cable and Nelson or something. But it was a console piano. And I said something to him to the effect of 'Man, there's nothing wrong with the piano. It must be you.' And they said something back to me and left.

So it just happened that these two guys was George Treadwell, the trumpet player that was formerly married to Sarah Vaughan, and Bud Powell was the kid's name. And I didn't see Bud again until after I got to New York, which I'll talk about later, and we really became friends. But Bud must have been about 16 years old then -- he was very young, as I was saying. The band that he was with... It keeps coming to mind that he was with Tiny Bradshaw's band. But when I got to New York a year or so later, he was with…
